capabilities: Download a daily bundle of newsletters, RSS items, and articles into the vault as Markdown
Upload a Kindle's My Clippings.txt file to the newslog server for highlight processing
Download highlighted articles with embedded highlights into a configured vault folder
Configure API credentials, folder paths, and per-date download history
extras: The service is currently in free waitlist mode; pricing will be introduced later. Kindle highlight processing happens on the newslog servers (the My Clippings.txt file is uploaded), which is worth noting for privacy-sensitive users.
motivation: The author couldn't find a good way to manage newsletters and RSS feeds: they were lost in the inbox, read-later apps forced in-app reading, and Kindle-sending apps cluttered the device; they wanted the full article synced with highlights embedded for PKM.
problem: Newsletters and read-it-later articles get lost in the inbox, and read-it-later apps capture highlights without the surrounding article context your vault needs.

relations.evidence: Download your complete daily digests in Markdown format directly into your Obsidian vault.
Sync your highlights by uploading the My Clippings.txt file from your Kindle device.

requires.name: newslog.me account with API Key and API Password
newslog.me pricing planned for the future
Kindle via USB for My Clippings.txt (highlights sync only)

summary: Syncs daily newsletter and RSS digest bundles from newslog.me, plus Kindle highlights with full article context, into your vault as Markdown.
